(b) for every output mode i (m = 5) and Bell pair (B, B'), two polynomial identities in the 2m^2 real entries of U, by exact expansion over Q: (I1) sum_n n_i A_B(n) conj(A_B'(n)) = sum_{j,l} U_ij conj(U_il) H_jl(U^dag U) for every complex matrix U, with A_B(n) = <n|out_B> the permanent polynomials of domain/p3/poly.py bell_amp_poly and H_jl(G) = <a_l in_B'|Gamma(G)|a_j in_B> written with permanents of G; (I3) sum_{j,l} U_ij conj(U_il) H_jl(I) = <B'| O_A(i)(x)I + I(x)O_B(i) + c_i I |B> with (O_A)_pq = conj(U_ip) U_iq on qubit A's rails, O_B likewise, c_i = |U_i4|^2 for k = 1 (0 for k = 0)
about.statement: For every U in U(5) (one ancilla photon in mode 5 (input mode 4, 0-indexed), the only ancilla mode), photon-number-resolving detection, and every unambiguous assignment: (1/4) sum_B p_B <= 2/3.
written_steps: On U(m), U^dag U = I, so (I1) and (I3) give D_i[B,B'] := sum_n n_i A_B conj(A_B') = <B'|Ohat_i|B>.

Step 1: an assigned pattern has only its Bell state's amplitude non-zero (unambiguity), so G(n) = A(n)A(n)^dag is Bell-diagonal; Lambda_i := sum_{assigned n} n_i G(n) is Bell-diagonal and D_i - Lambda_i = sum_{other n} n_i G(n) is PSD.
D_i is the transpose of the Bell-basis matrix of Ohat_i; transposition preserves the PSD order against a real diagonal matrix, so Lambda_i <= Ohat_i.

O_A(i) = conj(u)u^T (u = row i on qubit A's rails) is PSD of rank <= 1, so equals s_A|a><a| with s_A = |U_i0|^2 + |U_i1|^2 and a unit a (any a if u = 0); likewise O_B; the lemma gives tr Lambda_i <= s_A(i) + s_B(i) + 4 c_i.
Step 2: every pattern has 3 photons, so sum_i tr Lambda_i = 3 sum_B p_B.
Step 5: unit columns of U give sum_i s_A(i) = sum_i s_B(i) = 2 and sum_i c_i = 1; hence 3 sum_B p_B <= 8.

lemma_certificate.statement: P3 one-body USD lemma: for unit alpha, beta in C^2, real s_A, s_B, c, lambda_B and W in C^{4x4} with s_A|a><a|(x)I + s_B I(x)|b><b| + cI - sum_B lambda_B|B><B| = W W^dag (B the Bell states), sum_B lambda_B <= s_A + s_B + 4c
